requestedByMatt: 18 October 2026: add Hawaii/Indonesia-inspired island biome and snowy mountain part
scope: Eight new proposed landscape segments, not eight new mechanics. The base contract remains frozen to its documented source; this additive contract is not imported by the game.

regions.name: Tidebloom Isles
regions.role: A separate offshore walking region; dormant volcanic relief and a sheltered lagoon, not another active lava country.

districts.name: Frostline Highlands
districts.reason: A continuous elevational extension above the existing ridge, with no second station or replacement mountain mission.

districts.name: Tidebloom Isles
districts.reason: A compact island circuit with one legible landing and a real sea gap from the mainland.

zones.name: Fir Hollow
zones.role: Sheltered subalpine trees and snow patches, reached west from the ridge cabin; steep bluff blocks the woodland below.

zones.name: Snowmelt Lake
zones.role: Open alpine cirque and meltwater lake. Dry shore path, supported stream crossing and a real outflow; no walking across thin ice.

zones.name: Snow Saddle
zones.role: Broad treeless shoulder; a safe switchback descends south to the existing ridge cabin.

zones.name: High Lookout
zones.role: Short optional terminal lookout on a broad path; distant peaks are scenery, not climbing or survival mechanics.

zones.name: Lagoon Landing
zones.role: Sheltered southwest shore, pier and clear return landmark; coastal mangrove fringe stays outside the dry route.

zones.name: Rainforest
zones.role: Northwest forested valley; stream from headwaters drains south to the lagoon, with supported bridge approaches.

zones.name: Headwaters
zones.role: Rain-catching upland and waterfall above the west-draining forest stream. Path skirts the falls, never runs up the water or over a cliff face.

zones.name: Black-sand Cove
zones.role: Exposed southeast basalt coast and sheltered path above the beach; no fresh lava, volcanic damage or tide gate.

connections.corridor: Cabin terrace bends into a sheltered fir hollow, with patchy snow before the alpine slope.
connections.frame: Rock shoulders and fir belts frame the only shared opening.

connections.corridor: Wide switchback passes thinning trees, then opens at the dry shore of the cirque.
connections.frame: Talus and a continuous visible scarp block all non-trail spans.

connections.corridor: Dry lake-bank route crosses the outflow on a supported footbridge and reaches the broad saddle.
connections.frame: Lake water and rock rim stay blocked outside the bridge and shore path.

connections.corridor: Long gentle switchback reveals the cabin roof and returns to the familiar ridge trail.
connections.frame: Stepped rock shoulders show the descent; no cliff-face walking.

connections.corridor: One short sheltered rising path ends at a broad lookout; no onward route into distant peaks.
connections.frame: Continuous rock and snow banks close the other edges without implying a timed closure.

connections.corridor: Dry shore lane climbs beside the stream through palms into layered forest canopy.
connections.frame: Mangrove water and planted slopes frame a wide supported bank path.

connections.corridor: Forested switchback climbs outside the waterfall gorge; bridge meets solid dry land at both ends.
connections.frame: Gorge walls and canopy close the seam outside the path.

connections.corridor: Terraced descent around the island's east shoulder; coastal cove visible before the final bend.
connections.frame: Vegetated basalt cliffs make the two-tier descent legible, never an unbroken vertical face.

connections.corridor: Dry coast path rounds a basalt headland into the sheltered lagoon and familiar landing.
connections.frame: Sea on one side, vegetated bluff on the other; reef and outer islets remain scenery.

connections.returnPolicy: Same two endpoints in reverse, always optional; no schedule, tide condition, fare, reward or forced return.
connections.integrationGap: The game currently has no boat service. Do not insert this into travelLinks, travelVehicle, saves or runtime RegionId from this proposal. Claude/Matt must approve the concrete transport adapter separately.

blockedAdjacencies.reason: Visible steep escarpment. The altitude transition is through the ridge approach, not a shortcut through the woodland canopy.

watercourses.note: Scenic drainage can cross closed foot seams; water continuity does not grant walk access.
Freshwater runs downhill west then south; sheltered brackish fringe is distinct from outer reef and exposed black-sand coast.

saveIntegration.reason: Extending valley minRow from -1 to -3 changes the absolute region origin even though existing zone-local coordinates do not move. Resolve legacy zone first, then retain local offset against final layout. Never just reuse/clamp old absolute y.
saveIntegration.islandDiscovery: New island zones stay unvisited until actually visited; do not award anything or mark them visited during migration.
saveIntegration.futureFields: Preserve unknown regions/discoveries and all unrelated account/save fields. This file performs no migration.
